notes: Candidate canary-grade evidence from a stock distribution llama.cpp build (0.3.0, build 10621, commit c1d0e7a00) on Apple silicon (Metal). It demonstrates the checks, not a supported runtime; rerun against the exact pinned build before treating any fact as qualification.

facts.hybrid_ssm_reuse_boundary: On divergence after a 1065-token reused prefix, the slot reused 553 tokens where the true common prefix was 1059; llama.cpp truncates reuse at the last recurrent-state snapshot instead of the true token LCP. Conservative and mechanically safe, but LCP-based accounting must not assume token-prefix reuse on hybrid backends.
